purpose: Compact terrace material plates, registered to shared normalized floor coordinates. Texture plates resize to the measured stage; characters and props preserve aspect.

Observatory.editPrompt: Edit this square empty game terrace for a short landscape display. Keep its material, colors, lighting and quiet uninterrupted floor. Make the FRONT / BOTTOM RIM a very thin edge within the bottom 3% of the image (y=0.97 to 1.0). Move the existing front rim and thick front wall completely down to that bottom edge. Expand the bare floor downward so it stays uninterrupted through y=0.96, including both lower corners. The floor must occupy x=0.06 through 0.94 and y=0.06 through 0.96 with NO raised rim or wall in that rectangle. Camera almost directly overhead; nearly zero front thickness. Keep the top and side edges thin, small rounded corners only. No grid, circles, markings, stars, props, characters, sky or text. Do not add a rigid outer UI frame. One simple painterly empty floor with a narrow physical edge.
